content.text: I’m planning on heading your way this week to get lunch with Tom Gage. Wanted to reach out to you before...is there a good day to meet up when you’re off work?
(Or even later in the evening if you have to get home for dinner with the fam and what not. I have family out that way I can stop in and see, too.)
I normally have a coaching commitment on Thursdays at 6:30 but I don’t have it this week due to mid winter break. So, that should be open for me
Ok, let’s count on that, I’ll circle back to you on Tues or Wed.
